verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents a provider package model in which 'Providers connect Crossplane to external APIs' and pitches managing 'any resource anywhere'. However, the only concrete provider example is AWS (RDS), and community comments refer to cross-cloud portability only in general terms. The breadth of the ecosystem across all major clouds and SaaS providers is asserted rather than shown. Missing for 10: a documented provider catalog naming GCP, Azure and SaaS providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-cloud and SaaS coverage.
